zh-CN.title: 合并聊天记录高度更加自然
items: 发言中的合并聊天记录现在会根据实际消息内容自然撑开
移除了短记录的大面积留白，较长记录仍可在限定区域内滚动

en.title: Merged chat records now use natural heights
items: Merged chat records in Square posts now grow naturally with their content
Short records no longer leave large blank areas while longer records remain scrollable
